why: Check 3's command fails as written. I checked each command against the repo (math.js, README.md, test/math.test.js, `npm test` → `node --test`), and those targets exist. Checks 1, 2 and 4 look valid. The problem is the regex in Check 3: `new RegExp('^#{1,6}\\s.*\\b'+n+'\\s*\\(','m')` sits inside a double-quoted shell string. Bash turns each `\\` into `\`, so JavaScript receives `'\s'`, `'\b'` and `'\('`. In a JS string these become `s`, a backspace and `(`. The pattern ends up as `^#{1,6}s.*<BS>add s*(`, which has an unclosed group. RegExp throws "SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression", so the script crashes instead of listing exports and missing headings. The criterion requires every command to run as written, so it is not met.
